visa_types.notes: Official German Missions in the USA page confirms a single Schengen short-stay visa category covering business, visitor and tourist purposes for stays up to 90 days.
Same official page as tourist Schengen visa; business is one of the listed purposes for the Schengen short-stay visa.

visa_types.visa_type_name: National (Type D) Visa – long-stay entry visa
visa_types.notes: Federal Foreign Office confirms the D-visa is the entry visa for stays over 90 days, later converted into a purpose-specific residence permit; listed under 'work' as it is the umbrella entry visa for most long-term purposes.
Confirmed on the official Federal Office for Migration and Refugees (BAMF) site: temporary residence permit for highly-qualified employment, generally issued for up to 4 years.
Official German Missions in the USA page lists a distinct document checklist for 'Skilled Workers holding a university degree' as a national visa category.
Same official page lists a separate checklist for 'Skilled Workers with vocational training' as its own visa category.
Official German Embassy (diplo.de) page confirms the points-based Opportunity Card, in force since 1 June 2024, allowing up to one year to search for qualified employment.
Official checklist page lists 'ICT' as a distinct national visa category for intra-company transferees.
Listed separately on the official checklist page as 'Research Visa'.
Listed as its own checklist category ('Au Pair') on the official German Missions site.

make-it-in-germany.com is the official portal of Germany's Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and BAMF; page describes the residence permit for freelance/self-employed work, distinct from the general skilled-worker visas.
Official checklist page lists 'Study' as its own national visa category, separate from PhD Study.
Listed distinctly from the general Study visa on the official checklist page as 'PhD Study'.

visa_types.visa_type_name: Family Reunion Visa – with a German Spouse/Child
visa_types.notes: Official checklist page distinguishes this from family reunion with a foreign spouse/child as a separate visa category.

visa_types.visa_type_name: Family Reunion Visa – with a Foreign Spouse/Child
visa_types.notes: Listed as a separate checklist category from family reunion with a German spouse/child.

Official make-it-in-germany.com page (run by the Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs/BAMF) describes the settlement permit as one of Germany's residence titles, granting indefinite residence and unrestricted employment.
